adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. Given the variable name and typical permission intent, this likely should be an OR; as written, a team admin who is not an owner will fail the permission check and can be incorrectly rejected with `FORBIDDEN` if they are neither organizer nor attendee. Additionally, for non-team bookings where `booking.eventType?.teamId` is undefined, both role checks run with `teamId ?? 0`, causing unnecessary DB queries against teamId 0.
